newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers upgrade Alcatel on Thomson news.
newsitem.headline: Brokers upgrade Alcatel on Thomson news.

text.p: Several French brokers upgraded Alcatel Alsthom after the government said on Wednesday it preferred Largardere's bid for Thomson SA, market sources said.
Cheuvreux de Virieu upgraded Alcatel to its recommended stock list (class "one") from a previous buy (class "two").

Morgan Stanley put Alcatel on its "strong buy" list from "outperform" and CCF Elysees Bourse recommended investors to "accumulate" Alcatel stock, on which it has a target of 500 to 520 francs per share.
Both Alcatel and Lagardere had bid for Thomson.
At mid-session Alcatel was up 2..522 percent at 456.1 francs per share.
Brokers said the share was up on short-covering by investors who had sold in the belief that shares would fall on a possible purchase of Thomson.
Fund managers had also been light of Alcatel for the same reason and were adjusting their positions, brokers said.
